items.title: Cerebras stock surges on Microsoft deal: What it means for Nvidia
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa outlines how various AI companies are storming the AI castle and searching for Nvidia (NVDA) alternatives, such as Cerebras' (CBRS) deal with Microsoft (MSFT).

items.title: Microsoft continues to restore Outlook email after outage, rules out 'cyber or AI' agents
items.summary: Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack or AI agents as the cause of an outage affecting email and other software tools across regions from Thursday into Friday.

items.title: Microsoft's latest outage hit Outlook and Copilot — what it means for your email
items.summary: No one has confirmed what caused the Microsoft outage that took down Outlook and Copilot, and nothing links it to layoffs or AI, but it's not the first time Microsoft's own changes broke its apps.

items.title: Why Billionaire investor Bill Ackman isn't touching Anthropic
items.summary: Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at the Invest 2026 Conference.

items.title: Microsoft Outlook outage shows how much of the world runs on a few tech layers
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley, discuss Microsoft (MSFT) Outlook, Teams, and 365 outage, affecting companies across the globe and exposing a reliance on technological infrastructure providers.

items.title: Nvidia market value sinks, Microsoft races to fix outlook after outage, PPI data read on inflation
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Jake Conely, and Pras Subramanian, tackle the top stories of the day, including Nvidia (NVDA) losing $1.6 trillion amid a sell-off as the stock falls for the sixth straight week, and Microsoft (MSFT) continuing to deal with outages affecting Outlook, Copilot, and Teams. Plus, US producer prices rose 0.3% in October, easing some inflation concerns.

items.title: Microsoft Service Outage Gives Software Giant Black Eye
items.summary: Microsoft stock wobbled after a widespread outage of Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook and Teams, hobbled business and government users.

items.title: AMD Stock Looks Poised to Revisit Its All-Time Highs
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices’ (AMD) stock looks poised to revisit its all-time highs. The market has already bought into its growth story. Now, the next opportunity may lie in how much of that growth turns into profits. After a triple-digit gain in 2026, the stock has pulled back from its October record highs, but the fundamentals help explain much of that rally.
